docs.title: Augmented Software Engineering
docs.text:
Build software. Use AI. Understand what you build.

A part-time program at Holberton School Albania. Learn the tools, the fundamentals and the full web stack, then build a portfolio with an AI assistant at your side.

docs.title: The journey
docs.text:
Four stages, each building on the one before, with career preparation running alongside the whole way.

    Explore

    Explore

    Alongside every stage

    Personal projects, mock interviews, CV and portfolio reviews, and practice presenting your work.

docs.title: What you will build
docs.text:
The last stage is your portfolio: two tracks of work you can show to an employer.

  • AI-Augmented Builds

    Take a product from idea to MVP with an AI assistant: write the specification, design the architecture, mock up the UI, prototype the API and assemble the MVP.

    5 projects · 40 h

  • HBnB

    A rental-listing web application, modelled on Airbnb and built in four phases: UML design, business logic and API, authentication and database, and a web client.

    4 phases · 360 h

docs.title: How you will work
docs.text:
The Holberton way: you learn by building, with your peers, and you leave able to explain and present what you built.

  • Project-based learning

    You learn by doing. Every concept comes with a project that has to run, pass the checks and be pushed to GitHub.

  • Peer learning

    You learn with and from your cohort: pair programming, code reviews and explaining your solution to someone else.

  • AI as a pair, not a replacement

    You prompt, review and correct AI output. The assistant writes a draft; you are responsible for what gets merged.

  • Understand what you ship

    If you can't explain it, you don't commit it. Reading and debugging code matter as much as writing it.

  • Soft skills

    Communication, teamwork, giving and receiving feedback, and presenting your work clearly to technical and non-technical people.

  • Work like a professional

    Git, pull requests, deadlines and code review from day one, and mock interviews to prepare for the real thing.

docs.title: Roadmap
docs.text:
Four stages, nine modules, 43 projects. You start with the tools, learn to program in Python, build across the full web stack, and finish with a portfolio built alongside an AI assistant.

4stages 9modules 43projects 776hours

docs.title: Where the time goes
docs.text:
Tools 60 h Foundations 88 h Software Development 228 h Portfolio 400 h

Projects run in the order listed below. Hours are the planned effort for each project.

1

A working development environment, the command line, version control, and an AI assistant in the editor.

  • Getting Started 28 h

    How the program works, how to think about problems, and the editor and assistant you will use every day.

    1. Holberton Introduction 8 h
    2. Introduction to Computational Thinking 8 h
    3. Open Visual Studio Code 4 h
    4. AI Assistant 8 h

    Tutorials

  • Shell & Version Control 32 h

    Move around a Linux system, manage permissions, and track and share your work with Git and GitHub.

    1. Shell, basics 8 h
    2. Shell, permissions 8 h
    3. Git: SCM Basics 8 h
    4. GitHub Flow: SCM Basics 8 h

    Tutorials

2

Programming in Python, from a first script to object-oriented design.

  • Python Fundamentals 48 h

    Write, run and structure programs: control flow, functions, data structures and errors.

    1. Environment & First Programs 8 h
    2. Hello, World 8 h
    3. Control Flow 8 h
    4. Functions & Modularity 8 h
    5. Core Data Structures 8 h
    6. Exception Handling 8 h

    Open module

  • Object-Oriented Design 40 h

    Model problems with classes, then describe and structure them with UML and design patterns.

    1. Classes & Object Model 8 h
    2. Inheritance & Polymorphism 8 h
    3. Abstract Classes & Interfaces 8 h
    4. Introduction to UML Modeling 8 h
    5. Introduction to Design Patterns 8 h

    Open module

3

The full web stack: storing data, serving it through an API, and building the pages people use.

  • Data & APIs 60 h

    Files, relational databases, ORMs and REST.

    1. File Handling 4 h
    2. SQL: CRUD Operations 8 h
    3. SQL: Joins & Relationships 8 h
    4. Database Design & Normalization 8 h
    5. Object-Relational Mapping 24 h
    6. RESTful API 8 h

    Open module

  • Web Front-end 56 h

    Structure, style and behaviour in the browser.

    1. Advanced HTML 20 h
    2. Advanced CSS 20 h
    3. JavaScript Warm-up 8 h
    4. DOM Manipulation 8 h

    Open module

  • JavaScript & Node.js 112 h

    Modern JavaScript, asynchronous code and the server side.

    1. ES6 Basics 16 h
    2. ES6 Classes 16 h
    3. ES6 Data Manipulation 16 h
    4. ES6 Promises 16 h
    5. Node.js Basics 48 h

    Open module

4

Two tracks of work to show an employer. First, five fast builds with an AI assistant across the product lifecycle. Then HBnB, a full-stack application built in four phases.

  • AI-Augmented Builds 40 h

    From idea to MVP, with AI as your assistant at every step.

    1. AI Specification Writer 8 h
    2. Architecture Blueprint Assistant 8 h
    3. UI Mockup from Text 8 h
    4. API Prototyper 8 h
    5. AI-Powered Startup MVP Builder 8 h

    Open module

  • HBnB 360 h

    A rental-listing application modelled on Airbnb, from design to working web client.

    1. UML 60 h
    2. Business Logic & API 100 h
    3. Auth & Database 100 h
    4. Simple Web Client 100 h

    Open module

Before you write real software, you need a place to write it. This stage sets up your machine and teaches the tools you will use every day of the program.

docs.title: Tutorials
docs.text:
Work through them in order. Each one assumes the one before it is done.

  • Zero Day

    What to expect, what to install first, and how the program works.

    Start

  • WSL

    Run Linux on Windows, the environment most of the program uses.

    Set up WSL

  • VS Code

    Your editor: extensions, the integrated terminal and debugging.

    Set up VS Code

  • AI Assistant

    An AI assistant in the editor, and how to use it without losing the thread.

    Set up the assistant

  • Shell

    Navigate the file system, run commands and manage permissions.

    Learn the shell

  • Git & GitHub

    Track every change, collaborate without conflicts, and publish your work.

    Learn Git

On macOS or Linux?

You can skip the WSL tutorial. Everything else applies as written.
